title: Stack Overflow
subtitle: complextro · a bass that changes patch on every hit, until it overflows
statement: Each bass hit pushes onto a stack and plays the patch at that depth; at depth 8 the stack overflows into a stutter and starts again.
intro: The first of the extreme ones. A bass that talks too much.

sections.name: Push
sections.intent: Kick and hats for the mix; growl hits filtered from bar 9.

sections.name: Push Harder
sections.intent: Snare and clap, the growl opens; a snare roll from 8ths to 32nds.
moves: Snare roll accelerates over the last 4 bars.
Half a beat of silence before the drop.

sections.name: Overflow
sections.intent: The full growl: patch = stack depth; overflow stutters every 8 hits.
moves: Stack depth → patch (FM ratio, fold, vowel, wobble).

sections.name: Core Dump
sections.intent: Kick out. Supersaw chords and a pluck sing the handshake; riser.

sections.name: Overflow II
sections.intent: The growl answered by lead stabs every other bar.

sections.name: Free
sections.intent: Drums and filtered growl, then drums only.

layers.name: Kick
layers.description: A big-room kick: hard transient, long tuned tail, driven.
layers.purpose: The only thing that doesn't change.

layers.name: Snare & clap
layers.description: Snare and clap on 2 and 4; the clap ratchets in 32nds on every overflow.
layers.purpose: The frame the chaos sits in.

instrument.name: Drum kit
instrument.description: clap, hat, kick, open, ride, snare

layers.name: Hats
layers.description: Metallic hats from six band-limited square oscillators (the 808 recipe): short closed ticks and off-beat open hats, almost no noise.
layers.purpose: The tick of the groove, kept small.

instrument.name: Drum kit
instrument.description: clap, hat, kick, open, ride, snare

layers.name: Growl bass
layers.description: FM, wavefold and vowel formants over a clean sine sub. Patch = stack depth (1 to 7); at 8 it overflows. Since take 3 it rides above the warm bass, high-passed at 220 Hz: the bite and the talk, not the weight.
layers.purpose: The voice of the track: it talks, it shouts, it breaks.
layers.math: depth += 1 per hit; patch = depth; depth = 8 → 32nd stutter, depth = 0

instrument.name: Growl
instrument.description: Per-note FM, wavefold and vowel formants over a clean sine sub: complextro.

layers.name: Supersaw chords
layers.description: Wide supersaw chords in the break: Am, F, C, G.

instrument.name: Supersaw
instrument.description: Seven detuned saws per note, spread wide, through an enveloped low-pass.

layers.name: Pluck & answers
layers.description: In the break a pluck sings the handshake (A, E, A, C); in the last drop, supersaw stabs answer the growl.

instrument.name: Supersaw
instrument.description: Seven detuned saws per note, spread wide, through an enveloped low-pass.

layers.name: Synth choir
layers.description: A synth choir: four drifting, vibrato-ed saw singers per note through five choir formants, each chord walking its own vowels. No breath noise.
layers.purpose: Fills the top with voices instead of hiss.

instrument.name: Synth Choir
instrument.description: An ensemble of drifting, vibrato-ed saws per note through five choir formants; tones, no noise.

layers.name: Warm sub
layers.description: A sine with a touch of triangle, saturated so its second and third harmonics carry it; a soft thump per note.
layers.purpose: The warm foundation: it owns everything below about 250 Hz.

instrument.name: Warm Sub
instrument.description: Sine plus a touch of triangle, saturated for even harmonics, low-passed at 900 Hz; a soft thump per note.

instrument.name: Transition FX
instrument.description: Noise risers, downlifters, impacts, crashes, reversed crashes and sub drops.

layers.name: Recursion (robot)
layers.description: Hard-tuned, ring-modulated: a thought thinking about itself, one more level each time, until the stack overflows.

instrument.name: Electric Bat voice
instrument.description: The project's singing synthesizer: lyrics to phonemes, a human performance, autotune, then production.

layers.name: Voice (core dump)
layers.description: In the break the recursion stops and a human voice asks the question under it.

instrument.name: Electric Bat voice
instrument.description: The project's singing synthesizer: lyrics to phonemes, a human performance, autotune, then production.

layers.name: Robots
layers.description: A machine reconfiguring into each drop, a charge shot fired into the half beat of silence, a heavy cannon on the downbeat, a mainframe stuck in an error loop in the break.

instrument.name: Robot rack
instrument.description: Machines from the batsynth robot library (servos, droids, modems, coils, turbines, alarms, clocks).

lanes.name: stack depth
lanes.description: The growl's stack depth (its patch); 8 overflows.

lanes.name: tension (plan)
lanes.description: How tense each section is meant to feel.

annotations.text: Snare roll: 8ths, 16ths, 32nds, then half a beat of nothing.
Core dump: the handshake on a pluck.
